caveats: Power BI Desktop practice export only; no embedded report or external credential is connected.
CFS Economics is screening-level context, not a formal appraisal or billing determination.
Tables exclude contact fields, credential fields, model internals, and probability-style outputs.

concepts.description: Event or measurement table, such as scenario_output_fact or parcel_economic_signal_fact.
Descriptive lookup table, such as scenario_dim or geography_dim.
Connection between matching fields in two tables.
Calculated value used by cards, charts, or matrices.
Reusable dataset, relationship, and measure layer behind a report.

import_steps: Beginner path: download the CSV files from CFS Economics -> Power BI & Tools.
Open Power BI Desktop and choose Get Data -> Text/CSV for each fact and dimension table.
Import economics_kpi_fact and parcel_economic_signal_fact first for Page 1.
Import scenario_output_fact and scenario_dim for the Scenario Planning Model page.
Create the two starter relationships listed in this guide.
Build the four report pages with the suggested visuals.
Use the JSON pack later for app-to-app integration or semantic-model automation.
Use economic_segment as an early slicer before comparing value-per-acre visuals.
Add caveat text boxes so report viewers understand this is practice/export context.

visuals.title: Fiscal attractiveness chart
visuals.value: Count or categorized display of fiscal_attractiveness_band

pages.purpose: Show what data is strong versus incomplete.

quality_checks: Slicers do not create misleading blanks.
Value-per-acre visuals are filtered by economic_segment before interpretation.
relationship_guidance: Start with the scenario and geography relationships.
Keep remaining tables disconnected at first if needed.
Use slicers carefully because some tables are summary-level rather than parcel-level.
Do not force incorrect relationships just to connect everything.
Use economic_segment to avoid comparing residential, institutional, infrastructure, and corridor assets as if they were peers.

relationships.guidance: Use this first for Scenario Planning Model slicers and comparison visuals.
Use this for geography slicers on parcel/site screening visuals.

report_builder_guide.measure_caveat: Field names may need small adjustments after import depending on how Power BI expands the JSON.

visuals: KPI cards: assessed value coverage, underbuilt candidates, opportunity signals, data confidence

domain_readiness_dim.next_data_need: Add current appraisal extract if missing.
Add official utility, school, and transportation service assumptions.
